old_problem: Copied fabric selectors do not prove any OCP module, proprietary TX/RX flags lack observing-side authority, and no independent-management traffic/counter/service oracle distinguishes this case from row61.
disposition_reason: OCP identity can be parameterized but AMD flag/selector meaning and the direction-specific observer cannot. These are core command semantics under ED-03. Without them, a broad log or generic service check cannot prove TX versus RX nor distinct OCP coverage, and an incorrect target could remove management. Pending/BLOCKED remains until vendor and project authorities supply the direction and recovery contract.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row62, AI fields, historical record2463, PCIe companion and next ECRC row63.
Preserved every OCP slot plus separate TX and RX LCRC coverage.
Required module/interface/service identity, independent OOB and directed disposable traffic.
Bound evidence to receiving-side replay/counters and post-service health rather than generic logs.
No hardware installation, traffic fault, setting change, retrain, reset or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: OCP directional LCRC replay with interface/service recovery
test_case.purpose: For each required OCP module, prove separate TX/RX LCRC stimuli on the mapped link yield the documented directional replay/counter evidence while preserving interface and dependent services.
required_package: Independent OOB and disposable bidirectional traffic
Directional link/NIC/AER counters or approved analyzer
test_case.test_command: Do not use the copied tuple. After approval, isolate one mapped OCP interface, baseline directed traffic and counters, perform one authorized TX stimulus and later one RX stimulus, correlate receiving-side replay and packet/service outcome, then restore configuration and link state before another module.
test_case.expected_result: Each flag affects only the signed direction and produces the expected bounded replay/counter delta; no fatal escalation, unintended management loss, driver reset, persistent packet loss, retrain, link downgrade or service degradation remains.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without authoritative flags/selectors and attributable direction evidence. Tool PASS, broad logs, copied tuple, indistinguishable TX/RX evidence, critical-service loss or degraded link fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated OCP path with independent OOB and no production traffic.
One verified interface/direction at a time.
Abort on wrong counter/interface, service loss, reset, retrain, downgrade or fatal escalation.
No automatic retry; retain counters and traffic evidence.
expected_evidence: OCP topology/dependency and vendor flag contracts
Packet, link, interface and service outcomes
test_case.recovery: Stop traffic/injection, preserve evidence, restore saved AER/severity/SyncFlood/HDT/BIOS and link state, recover the OCP driver/interface over independent OOB and verify all dependent services. Execution remains blocked until approved.
